text: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: After systematic learning and meeting graduation requirements, students will be awarded MBBS degree. Students will be given the bachelor's degree of medicine if they pass the graduation exam (including exam on medical knowledge and exam on clinical skills) . The program pays much attention to cultivating clinicians who have profound professional integrity, solid ground of basic medicine and systematic knowledge of clinical medicine and have acquired basic clinical skills as well as the ability to deal with problems in clinical settings. 2. Program Structure Editor Notes: There are foundamental, basic medical and clinical courses in this program. 2.1 Main Courses human anatomy, histoembryology, physiology, cytology and biochemistry, medical genetics, immunology, pathogenic biology, pathology, pathophysiology, pharmacology, diagnostics, internal medicine, surgery, obstetrics and gynecology, pediatrics, traditional Chinese medicine, psychiatry, etc. 2.2 Teaching Arrangement for MBBS 2.3 Credit Requirements The students should complete 203.5 credits, among which premed pubic courses are 26.5 credits, basic medical courses 48.5 credits and clinical medical courses 54.5 credits. The clinical rotation makes 74 credits. 2.4 Internship and Career Internship: Tongji University has 5 affiliated hospitals (t he duration of the internship is one year (at least 48 weeks) : Tongji hospital, Shanghai No. 10 People's Hospital, East Hospital, Shanghai Pulmonary Hospital, Shanghai First Maternity and Infant Health Hospital. Notes: These are all high level hospitals and have 4,443 beds altogether. Students must take the final examination on Theory Test and Clinical Evaluation in WHU. Career: The graduates will be able to apply to take the medical licensing examination in the medical council to get registered and practice medicine, when they obtain MBBS Degree. Students have to do the degree accreditation first because of the regulations in different countries. Students who obtain MBBS degree can find jobs in government as well as private hospitals, nursing homes and other health facilities. Students can also open his own clinic or continuely study for master's degree. 3. Degree Awarded Editor Notes: Students will be given a medical degree by Tongji University. MBBS Degree : Students who meet the requirements of the teaching program and pass the graduation examinations successfully will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree by the Tongji University. The English copy of the degree will state MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery). 4. School Introduction Editor Notes: Tongji University has been included in the State-founded Project 211 and the 21st Century Education Rejuvenation Action Plan of China. After the establishment of the People's Republic of China in 1949, Tongji University became an engineering university following a nationwide restructuring of institutions of higher learning in 1952. It was the largest university of civil engineering and offered the most specialized engineering programs in China. The university has developed rapidly into a multidisciplinary university featuring sciences, engineering, economics, management, liberal arts and law, with the initiation of the open up policy under the authorization of the central government in 1978 , Learn More>> 5.
